decisions.reason: Because it was only launched in 2018 and still appears on the website, management is likely to continue it as a related portfolio item, though its lower visibility suggests a somewhat higher chance of withdrawal than the other two products.
Its own webpage indicates a visible public commitment to a very close-to-core product, so an escalation-of-commitment logic makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
As a newly launched core-adjacent product with its own webpage, it has enough investment and public commitment behind it that management would probably keep it on the market for now.
